Question: The value of \[\tiny\frac{(487{,}000)(12{,}027{,}300) + (9{,}621{,}001)(487{,}000)}{(19{,}367)(0.05)}\] is closest to
Solution:
The choices are far apart, so upper and lower bounds can identify the closest choice without a long exact calculation. Both numerator terms contain \(487{,}000\). Using the distributive property and adding the other factors, write the given value as
\[
V=\frac{487{,}000\cdot21{,}648{,}301}{19{,}367\cdot0.05}.
\]
The numerator factors lie between \(400{,}000\) and \(500{,}000\), and between \(20\) million and \(24\) million, respectively. Also, multiplying \(16{,}000<19{,}367<20{,}000\) by \(0.05\) gives
\[
800<19{,}367\cdot0.05<1000.
\]
All factors are positive, and the denominator is nonzero. Smaller numerator factors and a larger denominator give a lower bound; larger numerator factors and a smaller denominator give an upper bound. Thus
\[
V>\frac{400{,}000\cdot20{,}000{,}000}{1000}
=8\text{ billion},
\]
and
\[
V<\frac{500{,}000\cdot24{,}000{,}000}{800}
=15\text{ billion}.
\]
Throughout this range, \(V\) is less than \(5\) billion away from \(10\) billion. Choices A, B, and C are at most \(1\) billion, so each is more than \(7\) billion away from \(V\). Choice E is \(100\) billion, more than \(85\) billion away. Therefore the closest listed value is \(\boxed{10{,}000{,}000{,}000}\), choice \(\boxed{\text{D}}\).
